doc: The lattice repeats every 1024 cells (the index is & 1023, two's complement for negatives): 120 base points in cells 0..1023 with fractions k/64 (exact in float32), repeated shifted by multiples of 1024 (up to +-3 periods, both signs) and by -1024: F1 and F2 are bit-identical across the copies (asserted at build time). Default tolerance. The permutation input plan<i>.perm is the draw as recorded (256 entries for Perlin3, 1024 for Worley3); the kernel indexes it DOUBLED, concat(perm, perm) (512 or 2048 entries, so p[i + 256] = p[i]): a port that indexes the stored array directly runs off its end (see the .table cases).
